periodic_middle: omitted in default nearfield model; periodicity retained for geometry and imposed shear

production_numerics.fft: unused by nearfield; legacy mesh remains available
production_numerics.sparse_factorization: Sparse 6N current-Jacobian FGMRES; reused SPD contact-Jacobian LDLT preconditioner refreshed after >40 iterations; checked SPD direct fallback. Reference coupled scheme uses hydro LDLT and LU fallback.
production_numerics.contact_integration: IMEX implicit normal/sliding/rolling springs with immutable current-load friction caps and endpoint normal-gap correction
production_numerics.globalization: Exact convex Newton with original Armijo/directional search; after a damped exact step, one Huber quadratic-majorizer direction restores radial curvature for yielded sliding/rolling/twisting. Forces, frozen caps, timestep and physical residual gates unchanged. Primary budget 40 per inner solve; production wrapper permits up to 1000 total updates by default (40+960), configurable through SLURRY_IMEX_MAX_ITERATIONS. Recovery retains the current iterate and begins with a forced majorized direction. Convergence exits early; increasing the ceiling does not force extra work. Recovery use is logged; unmet residual is never accepted.

nonlinear_iteration_limits.batch_KRYLOV_ITERATIONS_controls: Linear Krylov iteration limit for each direction; does not set the nonlinear ceiling
nonlinear_iteration_limits.batch_settings_helper: apply_solver_limits.py adds IMEX_MAX_ITERATIONS and environment export while preserving existing run settings

contact_model: Implicit springs; Coulomb caps lagged from current physical normal load; finite-timestep cap-lag error is measured

contact_trial.basis: Preserved default kn30, kt=kr24 N/m from the prior release. Current bidisperse high-stiffness tests use kn300, kt=kr240 at unchanged dt; see validation_report for finite tested ranges.

initialization: stratified random two-species dilute seed; unconstrained growth/FIRE; actual per-particle spheroid periodic surface clearance certification
scope: Mari sphere lubrication plus local-curvature spheroid extension; isolated spheroid hydrodynamics; no many-body far-field model
validation_scope: User requested stopping long tests and packaging. Exact supplied N=1000, AR=5, phi=0.20 initial particles; kn=300 and kt=kr=240 N/m; dt=2.5e-6 s; eta=0.01 Pa.s; shear=100/s: accepted through step 1974, strain 0.4935, then Ctrl-C exit 130. Instrumented companion stopped after step 1917. Neither is a completed 4000-step test. Two v4 N=256 integrations completed: AR=1, phi=0.34 through strain 1 and AR=5, phi=0.24 through strain 0.25. Captured failures and finite transient checks pass; no strain-50 or attraction validation.

integration.method: Nearfield frozen-cap IMEX; coupled endpoint Coulomb optional; legacy mesh/direct Heun

particle_size_distribution.composition: approximately equal solid volumes; nearest integer counts
particle_size_distribution.nominal_diameter_definition: cube root of mean particle volume-equivalent diameter cubed

high_stiffness_validation.scope: Two completed N=256 finite transients and a user-stopped N=1000 partial trajectory through strain 0.4935 with v4 and a 40+80 budget; the final production wrapper raises the configurable default ceiling to 1000 and is checked separately. No universal stability bound.

partial_N1000_case.stop_reason: User requested stopping long tests and packaging current overlay

default_timestep_stability_scope: Finite validation only: exact supplied N=1000, AR=5, phi=0.20 case accepted through step 1974, strain 0.4935, plus the two completed N=256 cases. Does not certify strain 50, steady state, or attraction. Long integrations used v4 with 40+80 updates; the final configurable-ceiling wrapper has separate short validation in validation_report.
